annotations.text:
Landing page (direction B, chosen)
Light: Booba's airy structure and scalloped edges with the poster's warmth at about 70%. Fredoka + Nunito, kinder-* brights for accents and stickers, pastel washes of the same hues for section grounds.

Dark mode: the galaxy stays
Same layout, same components, same brights. The swap is only in the grounds: cream becomes gray-950, cards gray-900 with gray-800 borders, and each pastel wash becomes a deep nebula tint of the same hue (sky #16233F, mint #10291D, butter #332A12, blush #3A1B2A). The mesh gradient, purple/teal/pink glows, stars, and a shooting star live behind the hero and inside sky-tinted bands. Stickers keep their bright fills and pick up a gray-900 border, exactly as StickerBadge does today.

Admin dashboard
Same structure as today's dashboard (stats, fee summary, two charts, three panels), restyled: Fredoka for page headings and big numbers, pastel icon tiles per kinder hue, a sky-tinted welcome banner with one sticker and doodle, 2px warm-cream borders. In dark mode the galaxy is confined to the welcome banner so the working area stays calm.
Numbers and names here are sample data.

Parent portal home (phone)
Keeps the real hub layout: child switcher header, greeting card, eight cards with live badges, plus a one-line 'today' strip so a parent sees check-in and mood without tapping. Dark mode keeps the faint star field across the page and turns the greeting card into a night-sky card with a moon.
Numbers and names are sample data.

Unchosen directions, kept for reference.
A · Poster Pop: the flyer as a website, saturated primaries and ink outlines.
C · Booba Soft: sand and dusty-blue, Capriola headings, single apricot accent.
